title: Tuning the buried interface with D-sorbitol-modified mixed SAMs for high-efficiency inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20143-20156
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01990K, Paper
Open Access

Adem Mutlu, Necip Ali Tuna, Destan Toksoz, Cem Tozlu
One of the key bottlenecks limiting high efficiency and long-term stability in perovskite solar cells (PSCs) is non-radiative recombination and slow interfacial-process-related losses at the buried transparent conducting oxide/perovskite interface.
